description: Agentic Enterprise UC-3 — extract tenant, expiration, and liability terms from commercial real estate lease agreements. Output is shaped for direct ingestion into the DuckDB leases table.

tenant_name.description: Legal name of the tenant entity (e.g., 'Aurora Biotech Solutions, Inc.'). Look for the 'TENANT:' header followed by a corporate name and entity suffix (Inc., LLC, LP, Corp., Ltd.).

tenant_type.description: Entity type derived from the tenant_name suffix.

landlord_name.description: Legal name of the landlord/lessor entity.

premises_address.description: Street address + suite/floor of the leased premises.

rentable_square_feet.description: Approximate rentable square footage as stated in Article 1 (Premises).

expiration_date.description: Lease expiration date in ISO 8601. Look for the 'Expiration Date' definition in Article 2 (Term).

base_rent_psf_per_year.description: Base rent per rentable square foot per annum (USD).

renewal_option.description: If a renewal option exists, capture term length and notice window.

liability_clause_text.description: Full verbatim text of the indemnification / liability clause (typically Article 7). Required for downstream search by 'indemnify' keyword.

indemnification_present.description: True when the liability_clause_text contains the word 'indemnify' (case-insensitive).

indemnification_survival_years.description: Number of years the indemnification obligation survives lease termination.

insurance_required_per_occurrence_usd.description: Minimum per-occurrence general liability insurance required (USD).

insurance_required_aggregate_usd.description: Minimum aggregate general liability insurance required (USD).

default_cure_days.description: Number of days after rent due date before non-payment becomes an Event of Default.

governing_law_state.description: State whose law governs the lease (e.g., 'Texas').

signed_at.description: Most recent signature date on the lease.

extractionInstructions: This is a commercial real estate lease agreement. Extract the legal entity names, lease term dates, rent terms, and the verbatim indemnification clause. The liability_clause_text is critical for downstream search — preserve it verbatim including the survival provision. Set indemnification_present=true if the liability clause contains the word 'indemnify' (case-insensitive).
